text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Good day, everyone. Today, I shall 
introduce how I spend my days off.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Will this do for the opening?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To hype up "Dream Fest," we decided to 
conduct close, behind-the-scenes coverage 
of the racers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To capture her looking more natural, her 
trainer will be doing the filming. The 
plan is to start by recording how she 
spends her days off.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That marble dragon truly is breathtaking. 
The dynamic composition and the profound 
texture...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I can feel the creator's sheer obsession 
to 'leave a mark on this world.' The 
pressure feels like it's about to jump out 
and attack—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It certainly keeps me on my toes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Huh. A saltwater crocodile's bite force is 
strong enough to crush a car, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. A kick from this giraffe packs 
enough power to take down a lion in a 
single blow.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The "strength" to survive in a dog-eat-dog 
world. I wonder what other forms it takes. 
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that customer arrived, the 
animals have been awfully quiet and 
tame...

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text: Hmm, does she sense something in her...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the shoot of her day off, 
we moved on to the pre-race interview.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, it was heading towards the 
'Dream Fest', was it not?”
choice_data_list: Ah, let me hear your enthusiasm
Yeah, I want to hear how fired up you are.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Quite so...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Victory at the Japan Derby is a monumental 
honor.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to etch your mark upon 
history, then train diligently, aim high, 
and act with conviction.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Regarding those words from St. Lite. If 
you ask me, what path you have walked 
matters not.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The absolute strongest care not for the 
path. For the footsteps they leave behind 
become the path itself.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I shall demonstrate it to you. 
That undeniable truth, in this upcoming 
race.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The mighty rulers of each division and 
era... Let us trample every last one of 
them and etch our name into their minds.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The powerhouse standing at the pinnacle of 
all—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment she made her declaration, the 
surrounding air grew taut with tension.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So, is there anything else you'd like to 
ask?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave. I look 
forward to seeing how the video turns out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After Gentildonna heads home, I review the 
footage we recorded today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind that graceful facade lies a fierce 
fighting spirit. Endowed with such 
contrasting qualities, she will 
undoubtedly captivate many. And—
choice_data_list:
(I'm sure everyone will want to see her 
run...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt the urge to deliver this video 
right away. So, I hurried back to Tracen 
Academy to start editing immediately.
